Test recordings

Each recording has 7 pressure sensors (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7) sampled at 1000 Hz. Features are computed on the valve-opening windows (0-100 ms, 400-500 ms, 800-900 ms), one row per window. Five tasks are trained on these features; the saved models are listed below with their test results (recording level).

Example signals

Mean amplitude spectrum of the valve-opening windows

84 features = 12 per sensor x 7 sensors, per window. Types: mean, var, kurt, skew, p2p, energy, shape, clearance, impulse, apeak1, apeak2, apeak3. Left out: crest, fpeak1, fpeak2, fpeak3, rms.

Stage 2a unknown detector: KMeans(k=3), fitted on the known abnormal training windows; a window is Unknown above mean + 3 sigma of out-of-fold scores (threshold 14.238). The training data has no unknown faults, so test_unknown counts known recordings wrongly flagged as Unknown.

Performance measures used

measure meaning
Accuracy Share of recordings whose predicted class is correct.
Precision Of the recordings predicted as a class, the share that truly belong to it (binary tasks: the positive class; multi-class: macro average over classes).
Recall Of the recordings that truly belong to a class, the share that were found (binary: positive class; multi-class: macro average).
F1 score Harmonic mean of precision and recall; low when either is low.
Unknown (Task 2) A window is Unknown when the stage-2a detector's score is above mean + 3 sigma of the known abnormal training windows. Training data has no unknown faults, so Unknown predictions on validation / test count as errors.
MAE (Task 5) Mean absolute error of the predicted opening ratio, in percentage points, before rounding to the nearest level.
Recording level Each recording has 3 valve-opening windows. Classifiers vote over the windows; the Task 5 regression averages them.
Validation / test Validation is used while choosing models; test is the held-out check. Task 5 uses a 70/30 train/test split without validation.
